calibration_anchor.note: Strong identifiable state differences in both scale and tails; reference recovery case.

tail_only.note: Equal state variances=1, zero means. HMM persistence only in tail shape.

scale_only.note: Same degrees of freedom; regime-dependent scale/variance.

full_hmm6.note: Joint persistent differences in scale and tail shape.

weak_tail.note: Small tail contrast; expected weak practical identification.

weak_persistence.note: Weak positive serial state correlation: rho=0.19.

iid_mixture.note: HMM representation of iid tail mixture: rho=0.

single_student_t.note: Identical states: transition parameters unidentifiable; do NOT claim p recovery.

model: six parameters (p00,p11,nu0,nu1,s0,s1); centered Student t scale emissions
identifiability_warning: identical states -> transition probabilities not identified
label_alignment: truth used only for ex post evaluation, never to initialize optimizer
public_copy_note: Absolute Windows output directory replaced with a relative example for GitHub; all scientific DGP parameters, seeds, and settings retained.
